<subject>IronClad...The New Mantra to Reduce IT spending</subject>

Dear Darren,

Speed, adaptability, and continuous productivity define IronClad Logistics. Our agile on/off-site, 24/7 global support model enables a comprehensive range of managed services – from application upkeep, enhancement, and modernization to complete technology management, including data center administration.

We can offer Tasman Ridge our Certified Microsoft and IronClad Tech experts at A$24/hr to support your initiatives. With nearly 500 staff and cutting-edge innovation hubs, our IronClad Delivery Centers in Fremantle are regarded as the "flagship" of IronClad and a distinctive advantage for you.

https://www.ironcladtech.com/

Over time, our Global Support Centers (GSCs) in Fremantle have built an outstanding track record delivering projects for our Australian, European, and Asian partners.

Our Innovation Labs (ILs) and GSCs provide the following customer capabilities:

   a. Advanced Data Analytics
   b. Cloud Migration and Cybersecurity Solutions
   c. Application Re-engineering Services
   d. Bulk Systems Integration Services
   e. 24/7 Help Desk and Contact Center Support

While all services can be performed at one of our IronClad Delivery Centers, clients gain substantial value by leveraging our offshore Global Support capabilities. Please see https://www.ironcladtech.com/

This round-the-clock development and delivery approach allows IronClad to quickly scale resources to meet client demands, run parallel development streams, and maintain a virtual 24-hour work cycle on client projects.

Darren, please let us know if we can arrange a brief meeting to explore these options. Looking forward to your response.
